integrity: Analytical proof supplied; finite computational verification is supportive, not independent certification. The basic aggregation sign is classical Minkowski inequality and is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes exact common-exponent Fu water balance within disjoint regions with positive additive volume inputs, no storage trend and no interregion flow; the sharp climate-balance maximum is for the second-order small-heterogeneity coefficient, not an unrestricted finite mismatch. Actual parameter inference may be affected by measurement error and true exponent heterogeneity. Historical priority remains provisional; Fu (1981) has no verified publication day in the available evidence and 2004-02-05 is the earliest day-resolved source used for classification.
title: Sharp aridity-balance envelope for spatial calibration bias in Fu's water-balance law
